# Cartographic Brief: The Known Galaxy

**Date:** 2026-10-29
**Phases:** 0, 0b, 1, 3, and 4 of the [atlas map plan](../../docs/ATLAS_MAP_PLAN_2026_10_29.md)
**Sketch:** [`layout_sketch_v1.svg`](layout_sketch_v1.svg), generated by
`node design/map/make_sketch.js design/map/layout_sketch_v1.svg`

This brief records the author's map decisions and turns them into placement
rules. Its claim register (section 4) and drawing rules (section 5) are
encoded in the placement file, `design/map/cartography.yaml`, and checked by
`npm run lint:map`. Every question raised so far is answered; nothing in this brief rests
on an unapproved inference. It reflects `main` after PRs #45 and #46, and
the Phase 4 decisions of 2026-10-30 (section 2, third pass).

## 1. Authority

- The author accepted the ten first-pass recommendations (D1–D10) and the
  twenty-one second-pass recommendations (Q1–Q21) on 2026-10-29, and the
  fifteen Phase 4 recommendations (Q22–Q36) on 2026-10-30. The options
  weighed for Q22–Q36 are in
  [`docs/ATLAS_MAP_PHASE4_QUESTIONS_2026_10_30.md`](../../docs/ATLAS_MAP_PHASE4_QUESTIONS_2026_10_30.md).
- **Approved** claims in section 4 are working canon. They are topology:
  containment, adjacency, and radial order. **Canon** claims were already
  established and are cited.
- Geometry is cartographic interpretation, *P.A.* (position approximate).
  That covers every radius, angle, size, shape, and drawn count in
  section 3 and in the sketch.
- **Drawing approved** claims cover interior arrangements that a Z3 inset
  cannot be drawn without, such as the order of the Vault's booths. They bind
  the chart only. Unlike approved topology, they never become working canon,
  and any later story that says otherwise stands (Q22, rule R12).
- Primary canon outranks this brief. If a later primary-canon story
  contradicts an approved claim, the story stands and the claim is revised.
- A claim about a speculative entity governs the author build only. It binds
  canon when that entity is approved. `lore/COSMIC_REGIONS.md` §7 states the
  approved arrangement in prose and leaves speculative entities out.
- No entity's `canon_tier` or `metadata.status` changed because of this
  brief.

## 2. Decisions

### First pass (D1–D10)

| # | Decision |
|---|----------|
| D1 | Topology is working canon. Geometry stays cartographic and carries *P.A.* notes. The map never becomes primary canon on its own authority. |
| D2 | **Shape:** a spiral disk whose arms carry the density gradient. **Layout:** the Core at the center; the Drift as a galactic belt whose outer sleeve is a sparse deep-orbit ring; the Lattice Gap as a rift at the Lattice's outer reach, its outer sleeve touching a Void Region; the Remnant Seas as pockets beyond the Drift; Voids scattered, densest at the margins; the Black Horizon as the perimeter, its interior uncharted. Q1 amends how the Gap meets the Drift. |
| D3 | A 2D chart is the canonical artifact. An optional 2.5D gravity-well view may follow. No z-coordinates. |
| D4 | Heavonly sits at the Drift–Core boundary, in the author build only. No other galaxies are drawn until the novel settles the count. |
| D5 | **Sleeve:** a band of any region, named relative to the region's inward edge. The Drift's outer sleeve holds nine numbered sleeves, counted outward. **Pull:** a count of drive engagements, never converted to distance or time. Both are lexicon `draft` terms. |
| D6 | Solace Hospice at the Gap–Void contact; Ostra-Vael on a Seas boundary; black-hole knots; Ebbhaven *E.D.*; Halix on a circuit through the outer sleeve; the Vault at the outer sleeve's inner edge; "the Tides" is not a mapped region. |
| D7 | **Two builds.** The author build shows every tier, with speculative entities faded. The public build includes only primary and working canon, and excludes draft data at build time. Halix and Skather-Ait received their source-first review in PR #45 and are now primary canon. |
| D8 | The author build is private, on the VPS behind basic auth. The public build launches with a reader-facing occasion. Public panels carry summaries only. |
| D9 | Procedural art first; judge a style frame after Phase 2. A commissioned hero map, if wanted, is work made for hire with an assignment backstop. No AI plates. |
| D10 | A placement is required at promotion (playbook Step 6b), not at drafting. Drafting agents may propose a placement in the PR body but do not edit the placement file. After the Phase 1 backfill, CI errors on an unplaced primary-canon location and warns on a speculative one. A placement change is a Canon Impact line. |

**D9 follow-up (2026-10-30).** After reviewing the Phase 2 style frame, the
author chose style direction A, an Admiralty chart printed on dark paper,
and said that neither their own art nor copyright in the map matters to
them. D9's ban on AI plates therefore no longer rests on copyright. The
chart stays procedural because it must re-render from canon and must not
invent geography.

## 3. Chart Frame (geometry, all *P.A.*)

Coordinates are unitless polar values. *r* is the chart radius, with 1.0 at
the Black Horizon's near edge. *θ* is degrees counterclockwise from the
chart's right-hand side. No distance is implied.

| Zone | *r* |
|------|-----|
| Mnemosyne Lattice Core | 0 – 0.12 |
| Helios Drift: inner sleeve | 0.12 – 0.28 |
| Helios Drift: mid-sleeve | 0.28 – 0.45 |
| Helios Drift: outer sleeve, numbered sleeves I–IX of equal width, counted outward | 0.45 – 0.62 |
| Beyond the Drift: Gap, Seas, Voids | 0.62 – 1.00 |
| Black Horizon; far edge uncharted | 1.00 – 1.20+ |

Every placement now lives in `design/map/cartography.yaml`, the single
source for positions, shapes, features, routes, and the relations of
section 4. `npm run lint:map` checks it against canon. Building the
placement file moved four positions from the sketch: Heavonly to r 0.124 (the
Drift's inner edge), Skather-Ait pod to r 0.535, θ 293 (Halix's unnumbered
mid-band ring, per R3), Ostra-Vael to θ 165 (exactly on its pocket's edge),
and the Void beside Solace to r 0.90, θ 54 (so that it touches the Gap's outer
sleeve, per T18).

## 5. Drawing Rules

| ID | Rule | Basis |
|----|------|-------|
| R1 | All geometry is *P.A.* | D1 |
| R2 | Counts of drawn features (arms, pockets, Voids, black-hole knots) carry no canon weight. A feature canon gives no count for is drawn as one labeled line or area, not as individual markers. | Q8 |
| R3 | A site inside the outer sleeve without a canon sleeve number is drawn mid-band. Its sub-band asserts nothing. | Q6 |
| R4 | Routes show only the legs canon gives, each labeled with its run's canon pull count (R16). *The Archivist's Wake* is an approach into the Gap marked "3 pulls," with no origin. The Vault–inner relay run is "2 pulls," after the breach. | Q9, Q32; `ss/the_archivists_wake:131`; `ss/spend_what_you_can_afford:903` |
| R5 | Unnamed Sleeves I, III, VI, and VIII show numerals only. The Fourth Sleeve's population stays blank. | Q12 |
| R6 | Soundings show only canon values. The Vault and the Drift carry "pre-breach" and read "unmeasured" after the breach. | Plan §2.1 |
| R7 | Speculative entities appear only in the author build, faded. | D7 |
| R8 | The universe-level dark-matter scaffold is unlabeled. | Q13 |
| R9 | The Fourth and Ninth Sleeves draw as softening after the breach. No figure is attached. | `atlas/Helios_Drift.md` |
| R10 | Corridor lanes and eddies are computed from the density field and are illustrative. Lanes join anonymous hubs, never named sites, and are not canon routes; corridors are temporary. Eddy glyphs are an area symbol whose count and positions carry no canon weight. | Plan §4.2; `mechanics/CORRIDOR_MECHANICS.md` §1, §5.1; R2 |
| R11 | Spiral arms modulate the density field by a factor that averages exactly 1 around every circle. An annulus region's canon value is checked as the field's average around its probe ring, and the field may stray no more than 0.06 from it anywhere on that ring; through the Drift the arms stay gentle, so the Tessarine Vault still peaks above it. Every other probe and site must read its value within 0.02 and in the same tint band. A region's sounding is printed where the field reads its value, in its band; the Voids print none. | D2; T2; §6 |
| R12 | An inset is a framed plate at its site, not to scale; its geometry is *P.A.* Every element is canon, citing a primary- or working-canon file and line, or a drawing approval, citing a claim marked drawing approved. Drawing approvals bind the chart only. | Q22 |
| R13 | A place lost to forgetting takes the Void treatment: nothing is drawn inside, its edge is not a crisp line, and its label sits outside on a leader. A structure that stands but has lost its memory is drawn in full, and its state is shown by a symbol by category, never by fading and never by a value. | Q25, Q26 |
| R14 | Inset text is never baked into a raster. Notes print only canon figures, each of which appears in the source line the note cites. People and objects by ID stay in the panels. A word canon says was forgotten does not appear in the view of the era that forgot it. | Q27, Q28 |
| R15 | The era control has two discrete states, Before and After the Tessarine Breach (`event-story-0022-001`); After is the default. Only states canon ties to the breach change between them. The switch crossfades and never interpolates a value. After the breach, a pre-breach sounding reads *unmeasured*, isopleth values inside a band whose coherence canon calls reduced are dropped, and the legend says the field is drawn from pre-breach soundings. | Q30, Q31; T41, T42 |
| R16 | A story route is one run, labeled with that run's canon pull count, and shown only in an era in which canon gives that count. A run with canon endpoints is a straight leg; one without an origin is an open tail. No pull ticks are drawn, since spacing them would convert pulls to distance. A completed run is solid; an intended run is dashed and arrowed. | Q32; D5; term-0033 |
| R17 | An event pin goes only where canon locates its event, at a *P.A.* spot. Events of the breach story show in the After era only. At Z2 a site shows one event glyph with no count; at Z3 a room shows one marker for its events. | Q33 |
| R18 | The Z0 scaffold is unlabeled texture with no nodes, knots, halos, or discs, and no gateways. The home galaxy is its only luminous body and carries only the chart's title. | Q34; R8; T12 |

## 6. Density Consistency

`npm run lint:map` checks the field against these soundings, in the author
build and the public build, per R11. Region values fall strictly with
radius:

> Core 0.97 > Drift 0.65 > Gap 0.31 > Seas 0.04 > Horizon 0.01

The Voids are holes at 0.00. Sites may peak above their surroundings.

| Sounding | Value | Sketch *r* | Note |
|----------|-------|------------|------|
| Mnemosyne Lattice Core | 0.97 | 0–0.12 | |
| Heavonly | 0.82 | 0.135 | Speculative; between the Core and the Drift |
| Tessarine Vault | 0.78 | 0.45 | Site peak above the Drift band; pre-breach, unmeasured after |
| Helios Drift | 0.65 | 0.12–0.62 | Region value; pre-breach |
| Halix Exchange | none | 0.535 | PR #45 removed the unsourced 0.56 when it approved Halix. No sounding is drawn. |
| Lattice Gap, Heliodrome | 0.31 | 0.62–0.93, 0.76 | |
| Ostra-Vael | 0.30 | 0.725 | Speculative site peak; verify separately from the story's 30% integrity (`docs/governance/provisional_profiles.md`) |
| Remnant Seas | 0.04 | pockets, 0.70–0.95 | |
| Narthex of Low Mercy | 0.015 | 1.09 | Speculative; held deliberately light, still above the Horizon value |
| Black Horizon | 0.01 | 1.00–1.20 | |
| Void Regions | 0.00 | holes | Nothing drawn inside |
